ijjhati: Ijjhati [Vedic ṛdhyate & ṛdhnoti; Gr. a)/lqomai to thrive, Lat. alo to nourish, also Vedic iDā refreshment & P. iddhi power] 좋은 결실을 맺다, 축복이 되다. 성공하다, 번성하다, 성공적이다 S I.175 ("work effectively" trsl.; = samijjhati mahapphalaṁ hoti C.); IV.303; Sn 461, 485; J V.393; Pv II.111; II.913 (= samijjhati PvA 120); Pot. ijjhe Sn 458, 459; pret. ijjhittha (= Sk. ṛdhyiṣṭha) Vv 206 (= nippajjittha mahapphalo ahuvattha VvA 103). <-> pp. iddha. See also addha2 & addhaka. Cp. sam°.
ijjhana: Ijjhana (nt.) & °ā (f.) [fr. ijjhati] 성공, 성공으로 이끈 Ps I.17 sq., 74, 181; II.125, 143 sq., 161, 174; Vbh 217 sq.; Vism 266, 383 (°aṭṭhena iddhi); DhsA 91, 118, 237.
